pinyin: Tā zhōngyú bōtōngle péngyou de diànhuà.
english: She finally got through to her friend on the phone.

sentence: 她害怕地捂住了自己的眼睛。
pinyin: Tā hàipà de wǔzhùle zìjǐ de yǎnjing.
english: She covered her eyes in fear.

meaning: to swap places; (logic) conversion; (car maintenance) to rotate (tires)
sentence: 我们应该学会换位思考问题。
pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi xuéhuì huànwèi sīkǎo wèntí.
english: We should learn to think from another person's perspective.

sentence: 妈妈轻轻地给我捶背。
pinyin: Māma qīngqīng de gěi wǒ chuí bèi.
english: Mom gently pounded my back for me.

meaning: to pay; to spend money; to fork out
sentence: 他主动掏钱请大家吃饭。
pinyin: Tā zhǔdòng tāo qián qǐng dàjiā chīfàn.
english: He voluntarily paid to treat everyone to a meal.

sentence: 他往茶里掺了一点蜂蜜。
pinyin: Tā wǎng chá li chānle yī diǎn fēngmì.
english: He added a bit of honey to the tea.

meaning: to dismiss and replace (sb); to replace (sb or sth)
sentence: 球队决定撤换表现不佳的教练。
pinyin: Qiúduì juédìng chèhuàn biǎoxiàn bù jiā de jiàoliàn.
english: The team decided to replace the coach who performed poorly.

sentence: 长期熬夜无形中损害了他的健康。
pinyin: Chángqī áoyè wúxíngzhōng sǔnhàile tā de jiànkāng.
english: Long-term staying up late has imperceptibly harmed his health.

meaning: to speak harshly but without any bad intent (idiom)
sentence: 她说话有口无心，别往心里去。
pinyin: Tā shuōhuà yǒukǒu-wúxīn, bié wǎng xīnli qù.
english: She speaks bluntly but means no harm, so don't take it to heart.

meaning: to aim at a target; to have a clear objective
sentence: 做计划要有的放矢，不能盲目行动。
pinyin: Zuò jìhuà yào yǒudì-fàngshǐ, bùnéng mángmù xíngdòng.
english: When making a plan, you need a clear target instead of acting blindly.

meaning: to spend all one's time together (idiom)
sentence: 室友们朝夕相处，感情很深。
pinyin: Shìyǒumen zhāoxī-xiāngchǔ, gǎnqíng hěn shēn.
english: The roommates spend all their time together and have deep feelings for each other.

sentence: 妈妈每天早上榨果汁给我喝。
pinyin: Māma měitiān zǎoshang zhà guǒzhī gěi wǒ hē.
english: Mom squeezes juice for me to drink every morning.

meaning: in disorder; at sixes and sevens (idiom)
sentence: 地上横七竖八地躺着几个空瓶子。
pinyin: Dì shàng héngqī-shùbā de tǎngzhe jǐ gè kōng píngzi.
english: A few empty bottles lay scattered messily on the ground.

sentence: 公园里传来阵阵欢声笑语。
pinyin: Gōngyuán li chuánlái zhènzhèn huānshēng-xiàoyǔ.
english: Bursts of cheerful laughter drifted from the park.

sentence: 这种药止咳效果很好，晚上睡觉前吃一片。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yào zhǐké xiàoguǒ hěn hǎo, wǎnshang shuìjiào qián chī yī piàn.
english: This medicine is very effective at suppressing coughs; take one pill before bed at night.

sentence: 今年雨水太多，地里涝得很严重。
pinyin: Jīnnián yǔshuǐ tài duō, dì lǐ lào de hěn yánzhòng.
english: It rained too much this year, and the fields are seriously waterlogged.

sentence: 杯子底下还剩了一点茶叶渣子，别喝下去。
pinyin: Bēizi dǐxia hái shèngle yī diǎn cháyè zhāzi, bié hē xiàqu.
english: There's still a bit of tea dregs at the bottom of the cup; don't drink it.

sentence: 妈妈在厨房里炖了一锅鸡汤。
pinyin: Māma zài chúfáng lǐ dùnle yī guō jītāng.
english: Mom stewed a pot of chicken soup in the kitchen.

sentence: 这篇文章的点击率突然涨了很多。
pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng de diǎnjīlǜ tūrán zhǎngle hěn duō.
english: The click-through rate of this article suddenly went up a lot.

sentence: 这块铁皮需要焊一下才能用。
pinyin: Zhè kuài tiěpí xūyào hàn yīxià cái néng yòng.
english: This piece of sheet metal needs to be welded before it can be used.

sentence: 她在晚会上独唱了一首英文歌。
pinyin: Tā zài wǎnhuì shàng dúchàngle yī shǒu Yīngwén gē.
english: She performed a solo of an English song at the evening party.

meaning: to answer a riddle; to guess (i.e. form an opinion without much evidence)
sentence: 孩子们围在一起猜谜，玩得很开心。
pinyin: Háizimen wéi zài yīqǐ cāimí, wánde hěn kāixīn.
english: The children gathered together guessing riddles, having a great time.

sentence: 由此看来，这个计划确实存在问题。
pinyin: Yóucǐ-kànlái, zhège jìhuà quèshí cúnzài wèntí.
english: Judging from this, there is indeed a problem with this plan.

sentence: 上课的电铃突然响了起来。
pinyin: Shàngkè de diànlíng tūrán xiǎngle qǐlái.
english: The electric bell for class suddenly rang.

sentence: 加班到深夜，他感到疲惫不堪。
pinyin: Jiābān dào shēnyè, tā gǎndào píbèi-bùkān.
english: After working overtime until late at night, he felt utterly exhausted.

sentence: 他打游戏打上瘾了，每天都要玩几个小时。
pinyin: Tā dǎ yóuxì dǎshàng yǐn le, měitiān dōu yào wán jǐ gè xiǎoshí.
english: He got addicted to playing video games and has to play for several hours every day.

sentence: 他说话总是盛气凌人，让人很不舒服。
pinyin: Tā shuōhuà zǒngshì shèngqì-língrén, ràng rén hěn bù shūfu.
english: He always speaks in an overbearing way, which makes people very uncomfortable.

meaning: to focus on; with a view to
sentence: 这项政策着眼于解决年轻人的就业问题。
pinyin: Zhè xiàng zhèngcè zhuóyǎn yú jiějué niánqīngrén de jiùyè wèntí.
english: This policy focuses on solving the employment problem for young people.

sentence: 他去邮局买了一张打电话用的磁卡。
pinyin: Tā qù yóujú mǎile yī zhāng dǎ diànhuà yòng de cíkǎ.
english: He went to the post office and bought a magnetic card for making phone calls.

sentence: 请您稍候，医生马上就到。
pinyin: Qǐng nín shāohòu, yīshēng mǎshàng jiù dào.
english: Please wait a moment, the doctor will be here soon.

meaning: lit. to make sb wear tight shoes (idiom); to make life difficult for sb
sentence: 领导因为这件事给他穿小鞋。
pinyin: Lǐngdǎo yīnwèi zhè jiàn shì gěi tā chuān xiǎoxié.
english: The boss made life difficult for him because of this matter.

meaning: to become infuriated; to see red; envious
sentence: 看到同事升职，他不禁有点红眼。
pinyin: Kàndào tóngshì shēngzhí, tā bùjīn yǒudiǎn hóngyǎn.
english: Seeing his colleague get promoted, he couldn't help feeling a bit envious.

sentence: 这所学校专门招收聋人学生。
pinyin: Zhè suǒ xuéxiào zhuānmén zhāoshōu lóngrén xuésheng.
english: This school specifically enrolls deaf students.

sentence: 他用船桨用力划水，小船很快前进。
pinyin: Tā yòng chuánjiǎng yònglì huáshuǐ, xiǎochuán hěn kuài qiánjìn.
english: He rowed hard with the oar, and the small boat moved forward quickly.

sentence: 老一辈人艰苦奋斗，才有了今天的生活。
pinyin: Lǎo yī bèi rén jiānkǔ-fèndòu, cái yǒule jīntiān de shēnghuó.
english: The older generation struggled arduously, and only then did we have today's life.

sentence: 学校号召大家节水节电。
pinyin: Xuéxiào hàozhào dàjiā jiéshuǐ jiédiàn.
english: The school calls on everyone to save water and electricity.

sentence: 秋天河边开满了白色的芦花。
pinyin: Qiūtiān hébiān kāimǎnle báisè de lúhuā.
english: In autumn, the riverbank is covered with white reed catkins.

meaning: Maotai town in Renhuai county, Guizhou
sentence: 他去过贵州的茅台镇旅游。
pinyin: Tā qùguò Guìzhōu de Máotái Zhèn lǚyóu.
english: He has traveled to Maotai Town in Guizhou.

meaning: maotai (a strong spirit produced in Guizhou); CL:杯[bei1],瓶[ping2]
sentence: 爷爷过生日的时候，爸爸买了一瓶茅台酒。
pinyin: Yéye guò shēngrì de shíhou, bàba mǎile yī píng Máotáijiǔ.
english: When grandpa had his birthday, dad bought a bottle of Maotai liquor.

meaning: erhua form of 茶館|茶馆[cha2 guan3]
sentence: 老北京人喜欢去茶馆儿喝茶聊天。
pinyin: Lǎo Běijīng rén xǐhuan qù cháguǎnr hē chá liáotiān.
english: Old Beijingers like to go to teahouses to drink tea and chat.

sentence: 譬如说，我们可以先从简单的题目做起。
pinyin: Pìrú shuō, wǒmen kěyǐ xiān cóng jiǎndān de tímù zuò qǐ.
english: For example, we can start by doing the simple questions first.

sentence: 那位教授到我们大学讲学一个星期。
pinyin: Nà wèi jiàoshòu dào wǒmen dàxué jiǎngxué yī gè xīngqī.
english: That professor came to lecture at our university for a week.

meaning: to do what needs to be done, without delay
sentence: 他决定装修房子，说干就干，第二天就开工了。
pinyin: Tā juédìng zhuāngxiū fángzi, shuō gàn jiù gàn, dì'èr tiān jiù kāigōng le.
english: He decided to renovate the house, and did it right away, starting construction the very next day.

meaning: to be honest; to tell the truth; to be frank
sentence: 说老实话，这部电影我觉得很一般。
pinyin: Shuō lǎoshi huà, zhè bù diànyǐng wǒ juéde hěn yībān.
english: To be honest, I think this movie is quite average.

meaning: come to think of it; speaking of which
sentence: 说起来，我们已经十年没见面了。
pinyin: Shuō qǐlái, wǒmen yǐjīng shí nián méi jiànmiàn le.
english: Come to think of it, we haven't seen each other in ten years.

sentence: 邻居们喜欢聚在一起说闲话。
pinyin: Línjūmen xǐhuan jù zài yīqǐ shuō xiánhuà.
english: The neighbors like to gather together and gossip.

meaning: erhua variant of 貪玩|贪玩[tan1 wan2]
sentence: 这孩子太贪玩儿了，作业总是不做。
pinyin: Zhè háizi tài tānwánr le, zuòyè zǒngshì bú zuò.
english: This child is too fond of playing and never does his homework.

meaning: while; taking advantage of (the time or opportunity)
sentence: 趁着天还没黑，我们赶紧回家吧。
pinyin: Chènzhe tiān hái méi hēi, wǒmen gǎnjǐn huí jiā ba.
english: Let's hurry home while it's not yet dark.

meaning: loser (as opposed to winner 贏家|赢家[ying2 jia1])
sentence: 这场比赛他成了最大的输家。
pinyin: Zhè chǎng bǐsài tā chéngle zuì dà de shūjiā.
english: He became the biggest loser in this competition.

meaning: to be known far and wide; to be well-known
sentence: 这家饭馆的烤鸭远近闻名。
pinyin: Zhè jiā fànguǎn de kǎoyā yuǎnjìn-wénmíng.
english: This restaurant's roast duck is famous far and wide.

sentence: 他的追悼会将于下周六举行。
pinyin: Tāde zhuīdàohuì jiāng yú xià zhōuliù jǔxíng.
english: His memorial service will be held next Saturday.

sentence: 中国古代发明了造纸术。
pinyin: Zhōngguó gǔdài fāmíngle zàozhǐshù.
english: Ancient China invented the papermaking process.

sentence: 他这次的婚礼办得很遂心。
pinyin: Tā zhè cì de hūnlǐ bànde hěn suìxīn.
english: This time his wedding was arranged just to his liking.

sentence: 这个水壶是用铝做的，很轻。
pinyin: Zhège shuǐhú shì yòng lǚ zuò de, hěn qīng.
english: This kettle is made of aluminum, so it's very light.

sentence: 工人们用铲子把雪铲到路边。
pinyin: Gōngrénmen yòng chǎnzi bǎ xuě chǎn dào lùbiān.
english: The workers used a shovel to shovel the snow to the roadside.

sentence: 这把旧刀上长满了锈。
pinyin: Zhè bǎ jiù dāo shàng zhǎngmǎnle xiù.
english: This old knife is covered in rust.

sentence: 他用锯把木头锯成两段。
pinyin: Tā yòng jù bǎ mùtou jùchéng liǎng duàn.
english: He used a saw to saw the wood into two pieces.

meaning: well-matched in social standing (of a marriage)
sentence: 两家人门当户对，婚事很顺利。
pinyin: Liǎng jiā rén méndāng-hùduì, hūnshì hěn shùnlì.
english: The two families were well-matched in social status, so the marriage went smoothly.

sentence: 工人打开闸门，水就流了出来。
pinyin: Gōngrén dǎkāi zhámén, shuǐ jiù liúle chūlái.
english: The workers opened the gate, and the water flowed out.

sentence: 他家新装了一扇防盗门。
pinyin: Tā jiā xīn zhuāngle yī shàn fángdàomén.
english: His family recently installed a security door.

meaning: to follow the crowd; going with the tide
sentence: 他没有主见，做事总是随大溜。
pinyin: Tā méiyǒu zhǔjiàn, zuòshì zǒngshì suí dàliù.
english: He has no opinions of his own and always just goes along with the crowd.

sentence: 没有网络的生活真是难以想象。
pinyin: Méiyǒu wǎngluò de shēnghuó zhēnshi nányǐ-xiǎngxiàng.
english: Life without the internet is really hard to imagine.

sentence: 爷爷从年轻的时候就喜欢集邮。
pinyin: Yéye cóng niánqīng de shíhou jiù xǐhuan jíyóu.
english: Grandpa has enjoyed stamp collecting since he was young.

sentence: 那个地区曾经爆发过霍乱。
pinyin: Nàge dìqū céngjīng bàofāguò huòluàn.
english: That region once had a cholera outbreak.

meaning: trials and tribulations; ups and downs
sentence: 他们两人一起经历了风风雨雨。
pinyin: Tāmen liǎng rén yīqǐ jīnglìle fēngfēngyǔyǔ.
english: The two of them went through many trials and tribulations together.

sentence: 这架飞机将飞往北京。
pinyin: Zhè jià fēijī jiāng fēiwǎng Běijīng.
english: This airplane will fly to Beijing.

sentence: 这头驴驮着两袋粮食走山路。
pinyin: Zhè tóu lǘ tuózhe liǎng dài liángshi zǒu shānlù.
english: This donkey carries two bags of grain along the mountain road.

meaning: the fabled roc flies ten thousand miles (idiom); one's future prospects are brilliant
sentence: 祝你鹏程万里，前途无量！
pinyin: Zhù nǐ péngchéng-wànlǐ, qiántú wúliàng!
english: I wish you a brilliant future, may your prospects soar!

sentence: 端午节的时候，大家一起赛龙舟。
pinyin: Duānwǔjié de shíhou, dàjiā yīqǐ sài lóngzhōu.
english: During the Dragon Boat Festival, everyone races dragon boats together.
